scope: The complete 10-pattern coordinate-permutation lookup coverage, checked through 120 bounded 60-rank blocks and a proved quotient/remainder join. The 32-, 256-, and 1280-case certificate pilots are also checked. Generic finite certificate joins cover every row for any positive chunk size with blocks times size equal to 360; their complete numerical chunk checks remain explicit inputs. This task does not claim full finite candidate-pair coverage or unconditional plane classification.
